_help: Routing rules for PrintRouter. Rules are checked top to bottom; the FIRST rule whose 'if' matches picks the printer.
Conditions in 'if' (all must match): color true/false, content 'document'/'pictures', duplex true/false,
paper, paper_type or tray (a value or a list of values).
paper_types and trays must be spelled exactly as the printer drivers name them; they are sent to the printer with each job.
content is only decided for color jobs: Auto mode counts a job as 'pictures' when the average color coverage
of its pages is at least picture_threshold_percent.
Files put in inbox_folder (also inside folders in it) appear in the app by themselves; once printed
they are moved to printed_folder, into a folder with the date. Both are next to the app unless a full path is given.
printers max_gsm: the heaviest paper a copier takes (Tesla, 2026-11-13: IM C4510 up to 350 gsm, IM C3000 up to 300 gsm).
A heavier paper goes to the first copier listed that takes it. Only website product papers name their gsm.
A rule's if_busy: the copier used instead when the rule's copier is busy with another PrintRouter job (colour: IM C3000 first, then IM C4510).

rotate_sort._help: Ticked by hand per file (A4 only). Copies take turns between these trays (A4 portrait / A4 landscape), so each copy lies crosswise on the one before. Keeps alternating across all files in one print run.

product_papers._help: PrintHub products: the website's Paper choice -> the driver paper type for print.pdf. Owner's rule (2026-11-05): 80 gsm is plain paper; every other paper is Thick 3 up to 256 gsm and Thick 4 from 257 to 300 gsm. Smooth white 350 prints as Thick 4 on the IM C4510 only (over the IM C3000's 300 gsm, see printers max_gsm). Every paper that isn't plain prints from the Bypass Tray (plain_paper_types, hand_fed_papers; Tesla, 2026-11-13). Kraft 400 is no longer sold. Not listed, so picked by hand at Layout done: sticker papers, label sheets, envelopes and board.

plain_paper_types._help: Tesla, 2026-11-13: plain paper keeps the normal tray; every other paper type always prints from the Bypass Tray (website orders and main-window jobs).

hand_fed_papers._help: Tesla, 2026-11-13: both sides on paper that isn't plain and is min_gsm or heavier is turned by hand (fronts from the bypass, turn the stack, Print backs); lighter special paper prints both sides by itself (duplex) from the bypass. The gsm comes from the website paper name ('Silk 250 gsm'); when only the driver paper type is known (website documents, main window), the paper_types listed here count as min_gsm or more.

pieces_per_sheet._help: PrintHub products: how many pieces of each size (cut_mm, whole mm, WxH or HxW) fit on an A4 or A3 sheet (Tesla, 2026-11-12). Layout done fills in pieces per sheet from this; a missing sheet size means no number.

website._help: Website sync (stage 5b): every check_seconds PrintRouter downloads the website's paid orders into Pending Orders. Runs only when printhub_token.txt is next to the app (the work PC). url changes when the domain is bought.
